nodes.label: Budju
nodes.role: Automated crypto/USDC portfolio tracker (budju.xyz/trade). This node is a read-only glance only — pool total, crypto/USDC split, and near-buy/near-sell/cooldown signals. No wallet connect, no trades, no full asset list, no live websocket here. Not mapped to a control-plane lane; it isn't a spend meter, it's a portfolio to watch.

nodes.label: Propfolio
nodes.role: Australian property portfolio tracker (private web app, propfolio.work, github.com/comfybear71/propfolio). This node is a status glance only — ok/degraded/error/unknown health chip with a short status note, plus a client/property count rollup and a stub properties list, all structured so live data can fill in later. No login form, no property CRUD here. Not mapped to a control-plane lane. Currently seeded as ok: household onboarding is complete (Stuart French + wife, ~2 properties on Bagshaw Crescent, Gray NT). This is still seed data, not a live probe — treat any single status here as the latest known report, not a confirmed permanent state, until a real health check is wired up. Whatever's found happens from Deck/Cursor separately, not from this node.

nodes.label: Same Game Multi
nodes.role: Same Game Multi — deck node; automation later. An Aussie sports betting SGM (Same Game Multi) product/project placeholder for Stuart. A separate entity, like Budju/Propfolio: no wires to Skidmarks, AIG!itch, or The Tab here, and no live odds API wired up — this is a placeholder node, not a betting product yet.
